title: Vigorously Stir-Fried Brazilian Rice Curry
description: A savory and dense post-workout dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, featuring green curry paste and bonito flakes.

ingredients.name: Green curry paste
ingredients.notes: Thai or Brazilian green curry paste

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in an iron teppan over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the green curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked Japanese rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Add the bonito flakes, soy sauce, sugar, and water, and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt to taste, then stir in the chopped cilantro.
Transfer the stir-fry to a serving dish and serve immediately.
Serve hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
Enjoy your vigorously stir-fried Brazilian rice curry!
Leftovers can be refrigerated for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 2 months.
